modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lilybloom: Blooming lily pads as a separate block: grow them with bone meal, they bloom on their own and generate in swamps. Shear the flower off to get a Water Lily that can be planted on the ground or in a flower pot. Required on both server and client.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.lilybloom: Blooming lily pads and a Water Lily flower you can pot.
